# 🎮 Feature / Task Title

## 🎯 User Story  
*As a [player/developer], I want to [goal], so that [benefit]*

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria  
- [ ] Describe what should happen or be implemented
- [ ] List each condition or behavior to validate that this is done
- [ ] Include expected inputs/outputs or interactions if applicable

## 🧱 Dependencies  
- Related scripts, systems, or Unity components
- Any asset dependencies (animations, sounds, models)

## 🛠️ Development Notes  
- Suggested file/class names
- Unity-specific implementation tips (e.g., use `Update()` for X, or create a prefab for Y)
- Link to relevant references (docs, tutorials, diagrams)

## 📂 File Location Suggestions  
- Indicate where in the Assets/ folder or scene hierarchy this should live

## 🧪 Testing Notes  
- How can this be tested in Unity?
- Any mock data or test cases needed?

## 🗂 Related Issues / PRs  
- #123 (e.g., "Player Movement Controller")
- #124 (e.g., "Character Animator Setup")
